name: 67. Bedrock Converse redacted reasoning round-trip (converse-redacted-reasoning)
description:
OpenAI (gpt-5.6-*) and xAI (grok-4.6) on bedrock-runtime Converse return reasoning as
reasoningContent.redactedContent - one opaque blob - while Anthropic and DeepSeek return
reasoningContent.reasoningText{text,signature}. The two are mutually exclusive and replaying the
wrong one is rejected either way: 400 on Anthropic, and on OpenAI/xAI an opaque

  500 "The system encountered an unexpected error during processing. Try your request again."

Bifrost modelled only reasoningText, so it dropped the blob on ingress, left the client holding an
empty unsigned thinking block, and re-emitted that as reasoningContent.reasoningText.text="" on the
next turn - earning the 500. Only reachable on turn 2, so every row here is a capture/replay pair.

Production path: POST /v1/chat/completions (and /v1/responses) -> bedrock provider ->
converseReasoningShape() picks the wire shape from the bedrock_reasoning_shape datasheet key,
falling back to family detection -> reasoningContent.redactedContent.

The "us." prefix on each model id is load-bearing: a bare id routes to bedrock-mantle, and only a
cross-region identifier reaches bedrock-runtime, where Converse lives. The blob is minted and
validated by the model, so it cannot be fixtured - hence capture-then-replay through a collection
variable, which runners/lib/chained-vars.mjs detects so sharding keeps each pair together.

The reasoningText half of the same invariant is already covered for Anthropic-on-Bedrock by
folder 46 and is not duplicated here.

item.name: azure/gpt-5.6-luna /bedrock converse turn 1: foreign redactedContent is standard base64 beside a toolUse (#7514) - converse-redacted-reasoning

body.raw: {"messages":[{"role":"user","content":[{"text":"Find the capital of the country whose largest city is Istanbul, then get that capital's current weather."}]}],"inferenceConfig":{"maxTokens":2048},"additionalModelRequestFields":{"reasoning_config":{"type":"enabled","budget_tokens":1024},"output_config":{"effort":"high"}},"include":["reasoning.encrypted_content"],"reasoning_summary":"none","toolConfig":{"tools":[{"toolSpec":{"name":"get_weather","description":"Get the current weather for a city.","inputSchema":{"json":{"type":"object","properties":{"city":{"type":"string"}},"required":["city"]}}}}],"toolChoice":{"any":{}}}}

exec: // Converse types redactedContent as a blob: strict SDKs (aws-sdk-go-v2, boto3)
// base64-decode it. Azure mints URL-safe Fernet tokens ('-', '_'), which fail that
// decode with "illegal base64 data" unless Bifrost wraps them (#7514).
pm.test('capture turn returns reasoning and a tool call', function () {
pm.expect(content.some(function (c) { return c && c.toolUse; }), 'no toolUse block - the defect needs reasoning and a tool call in one turn: ' + body.slice(0, 500)).to.be.true;
var redacted = content.filter(function (c) { return c && c.reasoningContent && c.reasoningContent.redactedContent; });
pm.expect(redacted.length, 'no redactedContent came back, so this row would test nothing - encrypted reasoning was not requested or was dropped: ' + body.slice(0, 500)).to.be.above(0);
pm.test('every redactedContent is standard base64 an AWS SDK can decode', function () {
pm.expect(STD_B64.test(blob), 'redactedContent is not standard base64, so aws-sdk-go-v2 fails with "decode base64 blob: illegal base64 data": ' + String(blob).slice(0, 80)).to.be.true;
// Save the conversation only when the capture proved what turn 2 needs, so a
// failed capture fails here instead of cascading into a misleading replay error.
var toolUses = msg ? msg.content.filter(function (c) { return c && c.toolUse; }) : [];
{ role: "user", content: [{ text: "Find the capital of the country whose largest city is Istanbul, then get that capital's current weather." }] },
// Answer every toolUse: a parallel call left unanswered is a 400.
{ role: "user", content: toolUses.map(function (c) { return { toolResult: { toolUseId: c.toolUse.toolUseId, content: [{ text: "Ankara: 18C, clear" }] } }; }) }

item.name: azure/gpt-5.6-luna /bedrock converse turn 2: replayed redactedContent keeps its upstream reasoning item id, no strip-and-retry (#7729) - converse-redacted-reasoning

exec: // Azure binds encrypted reasoning to the item id it issued it under. Converse has no field
// for that id, so it must ride inside the redactedContent blob Bifrost wraps. Without it the
// replay minted rs_<UnixNano>, Azure answered 400 "Encrypted content item_id did not match the
// target item id", and the strip-and-retry fail-soft answered 200 with the reasoning dropped.
// The row above only sees that 200, so this row reads the provider-bound request back from the
// log. The unit test TestConverseRedactedContentReplayKeepsReasoningItemID pins the exact id.
pm.test('capture turn produced a conversation to replay', function () {
pm.expect(pm.request.body.raw.indexOf('{{'), 'turn 1 did not set bedrockConverseForeignRedactedMessages, so nothing was replayed').to.equal(-1);
// The log row is written by the batching writer, so poll for it. Bounded: ten reads a second apart.
pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('baseUrl') + '/api/logs/' + reqId, method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) {
if (typeof rr === 'string') { try { rr = JSON.parse(rr); } catch (e) { rr = null; } }
pm.test('the replay reached Azure on the first attempt, with no strip-and-retry', function () {
var failed = trail.filter(function (a) { return a && a.fail_reason; });
pm.expect(failed, 'an attempt failed before the answer, so Azure rejected the replayed reasoning: ' + JSON.stringify(trail)).to.be.empty;
pm.expect(engine, 'Bifrost stripped the reasoning and retried, so the model answered without it: ' + engine.slice(0, 400)).to.not.include('Stripped unverifiable encrypted reasoning');
pm.test('the reasoning item reached Azure under its upstream id', function () {
var reasoning = input.filter(function (i) { return i && i.type === 'reasoning' && i.encrypted_content; });
pm.expect(reasoning.length, 'no reasoning item with encrypted_content reached Azure: ' + JSON.stringify(rr).slice(0, 400)).to.be.above(0);
pm.expect(BIFROST_MINTED.test(String(i.id)), 'the replay carried Bifrost-minted id ' + i.id + ' instead of the id Azure bound the token to').to.be.false;

pm.test('log row carries the provider-bound raw_request', function () { pm.expect.fail('log ' + reqId + ' never carried raw_request: ' + (err ? String(err) : (res.code + ' ' + res.text().slice(0, 300)))); });

// summary as reasoningText and the encrypted token as its signature. The next row replays
// that block unchanged, so this row must prove one came back.

signed = content.filter(function (c) { return c && c.reasoningContent && c.reasoningContent.reasoningText && c.reasoningContent.reasoningText.signature; });

pm.expect(signed.length, 'no reasoningText with a signature came back, so the replay row would test nothing - Azure returned no summary, or the token was dropped: ' + body.slice(0, 500)).to.be.above(0);
// Save the conversation only when the capture proved what turn 2 needs, so a failed
// capture fails here instead of cascading into a misleading replay error. The replay
// carries output.message exactly as Bifrost sent it: its source text is cut out of the
// response body rather than re-serialized from the parsed copy, so no escape or number

function str() { var s = i; i++; while (i < text.length && text[i] !== '"') { if (text[i] === '\\') { i++; } i++; } i++; return text.slice(s, i); }
if (text[i] === '{' || text[i] === '[') { depth++; } else if (text[i] === '}' || text[i] === ']') { depth--; }
// The signature is brid_<id>:<token> when Bifrost carries the upstream id inside it.
'[{"role":"user","content":[{"text":"Two trains 140 miles apart head toward each other; one leaves at 3:47pm at 62mph, the other at 4:19pm at 71mph. Work out when they meet, step by step."}]},' +

item.name: azure/gpt-5.6-luna /bedrock converse turn 2: replayed reasoningText reaches Azure as encrypted_content under its upstream id (#7730) - converse-redacted-reasoning

exec: // Replayed unchanged, the reasoningText signature used to stay a content-block signature
// only: encrypted_content stayed empty, the OpenAI converter dropped the content-only item,
// and Azure answered 200 without the earlier reasoning. The token must reach Azure as
// encrypted_content, under the id Azure bound it to. A 200 alone proves none of that, so
// this row reads the provider-bound request back from the log. The unit test
pm.test('capture turn produced a conversation to replay', function () {
pm.expect(pm.request.body.raw.indexOf('{{'), 'turn 1 did not set bedrockConverseReasoningTextMessages, so nothing was replayed').to.equal(-1);
// The log row is written by the batching writer, so poll for it. Bounded: ten reads a second apart.
pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('baseUrl') + '/api/logs/' + reqId, method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) {
if (typeof rr === 'string') { try { rr = JSON.parse(rr); } catch (e) { rr = null; } }
pm.test('the replay reached Azure on the first attempt, with no strip-and-retry', function () {
var failed = trail.filter(function (a) { return a && a.fail_reason; });
pm.expect(failed, 'an attempt failed before the answer, so Azure rejected the replayed reasoning: ' + JSON.stringify(trail)).to.be.empty;
pm.expect(engine, 'Bifrost stripped the reasoning and retried, so the model answered without it: ' + engine.slice(0, 400)).to.not.include('Stripped unverifiable encrypted reasoning');
pm.test('the reasoningText signature reached Azure as encrypted_content under its upstream id', function () {
var reasoning = input.filter(function (i) { return i && i.type === 'reasoning' && i.encrypted_content; });
pm.expect(reasoning.length, 'no reasoning item with encrypted_content reached Azure - the replayed reasoningText was dropped: ' + JSON.stringify(rr).slice(0, 400)).to.be.above(0);
pm.expect(reasoning.some(function (i) { return i.encrypted_content === token; }), 'the token Azure issued did not come back byte for byte').to.be.true;
pm.expect(wantId, 'turn 1 carried no upstream id in its reasoningText signature, so the id never reached the client').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty;

pm.expect(reasoning.some(function (i) { return i.encrypted_content === token && i.id === wantId; }), 'the token did not reach Azure under upstream id ' + wantId + ', got ' + JSON.stringify(reasoning.map(function (i) { return i.id; }))).to.be.true;
pm.expect(BIFROST_MINTED.test(String(i.id)), 'the replay carried Bifrost-minted id ' + i.id + ' instead of the id Azure bound the token to').to.be.false;

pm.test('log row carries the provider-bound raw_request', function () { pm.expect.fail('log ' + reqId + ' never carried raw_request: ' + (err ? String(err) : (res.code + ' ' + res.text().slice(0, 300)))); });
